definitions.gloss: to repeat; to reiterate; to do over and over
definitions.explanation: To perform the same action again and again in a systematic or deliberate way. More formal than 繰り返す and often implies purposeful repetition for learning or practice.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じミスを{反復|はんぷく}する。
{反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}で{技術|ぎじゅつ}を{身|み}につける。
examples.english: To acquire skills through repeated practice.

examples.japanese: この{作業|さぎょう}は{何度|なんど}も{反復|はんぷく}して{行|おこな}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: This task needs to be carried out repeatedly.

notes:
To do the same thing again and again in a systematic or deliberate way. More formal than {繰|く}り{返|かえ}す and often implies purposeful repetition for learning or practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反復|はんぷく}{練習|れんしゅう}: repeated practice, drill
- {反復|はんぷく}{学習|がくしゅう}: repetitive learning
- {反復|はんぷく}{作業|さぎょう}: repetitive work
- {反復|はんぷく}して{行|おこな}う: to carry out repeatedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繰|く}り{返|かえ}す: to repeat — the everyday word for repetition; much more common in conversation
- {反復|はんぷく}: more formal and written; emphasizes systematic, deliberate repetition
- {再|ふたた}び: again — simply means once more, without the "over and over" nuance
